reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that bridges WeChat ClawBot messages to persistent DSH agent sessions and returns responses through Tencent iLink.

summaries.zh: 将微信 ClawBot 消息接入 DeepSeek Harness，并通过持久化会话处理后回复微信。
summaries.en: Connects WeChat ClawBot messages to persistent DeepSeek Harness sessions and sends the responses back through Tencent iLink.

capabilities: Receives WeChat messages through the Tencent iLink service
Sends generated replies back to WeChat
Maintains persistent per-user agent sessions and conversation context
Stores configured service credentials in the profile configuration
